posts.title: Vibe coded replacement for the Dataprep.ai Python library
posts.description: I’m sharing a Python script that replaces Dataprep cleaning functions that I’ve incorporated in Power Query data transformation jobs for the past few years. It’s called contact_cleaning.py , and it cleans up email addresses, phone numbers, and contact names. This script is provided here free of charge under CC BY-SA creative commons licensing with no warranty whatsoever: Download contact_cleaning.
